resources.string: Hardware keys

Use a compatible OATH key for accounts, or a FIDO2 key for alternative vault unlock. Only accounts with supported parameters and names appear in the copy picker. Key-held accounts are not included in app backups. A key PIN is not your app password; repeated wrong PINs may lock the key. Support depends on the key and phone.

This sends the secret over USB or NFC to the key and leaves the app copy intact. Use a trusted key and a private connection. Key-held accounts are not in app backups. HOTP counters advance separately; do not use both copies interchangeably.
Require touch for this account (supported keys only)

The copy may have completed before the connection ended. Check the key before retrying.

A FIDO2 key with user verification and PRF can unlock this password vault instead of the app password. This replaces any previously registered key. The password still works, so the key is not a required second factor. App-password automatic backups resume after password unlock. Changing the app password removes key unlock.
Key unlock requires a password-encrypted vault with password authentication. Existing Keystore vaults remain supported but cannot use this shortcut.
Key unlock was set up. Keep your app password and a verified backup.

Enter the key PIN, not the app password, if needed. Repeated wrong PINs may lock the key. Connect or tap your registered key; the app password remains available if the key is lost.
